description: Put items in a flex layout container that arranges them in rows or columns which resize and reflow together, for example a wrapping grid of profile cards for team pages; a group is converted (Flex Layout > Convert to Flex Layout / Add to Flex Layout). Needs InDesign 2026 (21.0) or later.

container.description: Add the items to this existing flex container (its id) instead of creating one

itemSizing.description: Sizing of each item in the container

height.description: Height of the item: fixed, fill the space, or fit its content (auto)

width.description: Width of the item: fixed, fill the space, or fit its content (auto)

layout.description: Flex layout settings (Object > Flex Layout); only the ones you pass change

alignContent.description: How wrapped lines share extra space across the direction

alignItems.description: How items line up across the direction

height.description: Height of the container: fixed, fill the space, or hug its items (auto)

justifyContent.description: How items share space along the direction

width.description: Width of the container: fixed, fill the space, or hug its items (auto)

wrap.description: Keep the items on one line, or wrap them onto more lines

target.description: The items to arrange, in order; a group's items are taken out of the group (Convert to Flex Layout)

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

ungroup.description: Take the items out of a chosen group and add them one by one (false adds the group as one item)

name: create_flex_layout
title: Create Flex Layout
